reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001383 (the melody read from 001383a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Walter Bond Gilbert's dates (1829–1910) are from https://hymnary.org/person/Gilbert_WB (Gilbert, Walter Bond, 1829-1910); https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/no2014165291 (Gilbert, Walter B. (Walter Bond), 1829-1910, citing Humphreys' Dictionary of composers for the Church: born April 21, 1829, Exeter, died March 2, 1910, Oxford); CCEH's page gives only the year 1862. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001383a.nwc).
